name: README.md
html:
burn — mosaic title paper-combustion sim

~54 KB. Lazy artifact — mounts on mosaic-tile interaction. The existing canvas burn is the fallback. This is the only widget whose simulation runs on the CPU side of wasm (sim.rs) — particles are too stateful for a stateless fragment shader.

 tile interaction → mountWebGpuWidget(BURN, canvas)
        │
        ▼
 begin(dir, ox, oy, seed) → set_letters(f32[6×n])
   set_ink(f32[w]) → set_colors(f32[12]) → sim ready
        │
        ▼
 per frame: tick(dt) integrates ≤110 particles (xorshift32 RNG —
   deterministic replay), emits 16-f32 instance records →
   storage buffer → ONE draw(6, n) instanced call

Why instancing via storage buffer

The sim emits a variable count of quad records per frame. A storage buffer indexed by @builtin(instance_index) needs no vertex-layout descriptors — one write_buffer per frame, one record shape (4 vec4s) to keep in sync with burn.wgsl.

  • set_dir(+1/−1) — burn ↔ rebuild on un-hover (replay, not reset).
  • set_stage(v) / set_origin(x,y) — front progress + tile origin.
  • Letter stride is 6 f32s (x0,y0,x1,y1,v,delay) — mirrors the JS flatten order; P_MAX-equivalents documented in sim.rs.
